explanation: This is safe. strncpy writes at most 7 bytes and the following line explicitly NUL-terminates dst, so even when src is longer than the buffer the string stays terminated and no byte is written past dst[7]. A tempting wrong answer reads this as strcpy-style overflow, but the cap and the explicit terminator make it correct.
prompt: src may be much longer than 7 characters. Can copying it overrun dst or leave it unterminated?
